senses.gloss: लवण- + अम्भस् लवण- + अम्भस्, n. the sea of salt water, Matsyop. 40.
लवण- + अर्णव लवण- + अर्णव, m. the sea of salt water, Rām. 1, 1, 70.

लव लव, i. e. लू + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Cutting, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 17.
 2. Plucking, Nal. 2, 30.
 3. Reaping.
 4. Smallness, Bhartṛ. 3, 100; Vikr. d. 118 (अपराध-, A very small fault); a little, Hit. iv. d. 76 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3265); a piece, Vikr. d. 125; a drop, Kir. 5, 44.
 5. Hair, Ragh. 15, 32; wool, Man. 8, 151.
 6. A minute, and also a larger division of time.
 7. A kind of quail.
 8. One of Rāma's sons, Utt. Rāmac. 85, 8.
 II. n.
 1. The nutmeg.
 2. Cloves.
 --Comp.

लाव लाव, i. e. लू + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Cutting.
 2. Plucking, Ragh. 13, 43.
 II. m., and f. वा, A sort of quail, Perdix chinensis, Rām. 3, 53, 57.
 --Comp.
लवक लवक, i. e. लू + अक, adj. Who or what cuts, Pāṇ. iii. 1, 149.
लवाक लवाक, i. e. लू + आक, m. A sickle.

लवंग लवंग, i. e. लव + म्-ग,
 I. m. The clove tree, Myristica caryophyllata, Ragh. 6, 57.
 II. n. Cloves.
लवट लवट, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 176.

लवण लवण, for original रवण cf. रुमण्वन्त्,
 I. n. Salt, Pañc. 184, 9.
 II. m.
 1. Saltness, Hit. iii. d. 56.
 2. The sea of salt water.
 3. The name of a Rākṣasa, Utt. Rāmac. 176, 8.
 III. f. णा.
 1. Light, beauty.
 2. The name of a river.
 IV. adj.
 1. Salt, saline, Pāṇ. iv. 4, 24.
 2. Charming, beautiful. []
 --Comp.

लावण लावण, i. e. लवण + अ, adj.
 1. Relating to salt.
 2. Salted.
लवन लवन, i. e. लू + अन, n. Cutting, reaping.
लवली लवली, f. A kind of creeper, Vikr. d. 146.
लवशस् लव + शस्, adv. In pieces.
लवि लवि, i. e. लू + इ (m. ?), An iron instrument for cutting or cleaving.
लवित्र लवित्र, i. e. लू + त्र, n. A sickle, Pāṇ. iii. 2, 184.

लावणिक लावणिक, i. e. लवण + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating to salt.
 2. Salted.
 3. Beautiful.
 II. m. A salt merchant.
 III. n. A vessel holding salt.

लावण्य लावण्य, i. e. लवण + य, n.
 1. Saltness.
 2. Loveliness, charm, Hit. i. d. 136, M.M.; beauty, Lass. 2. ed. 19, 3.
